failure_summary.description: The agent anchored on a salient passage repeating the split-in-half action and overlooked stronger evidence for the specific snack shown.

patch.reasoning: The existing guidance already calls for checking distinguishing details, but this failure shows the need to operationalize that check when several candidates share a generic action or attribute.

edits.content: For visual-identification clues such as “seen here” or “shown here,” do not choose among candidates by action-word overlap alone. When several items fit a generic action or attribute, compare all substantive passages against the full clue and favor evidence that directly identifies the specific item in the described state over an incidental anecdote about a related item.
